title: MxAgile Page YAML
description: A structured, semantic representation of a UI mockup page. Produced by the UI-Agent Analyze mode. Consumed by the Implementation-Agent and UI-Agent Verify mode.

source_mockup.description: Relative path to the original (immutable) source HTML mockup file. Never modified after acceptance. See policies/mockup-lifecycle.md.

target_mockup.description: Relative path to the ACTIVE acceptance target mockup used for implementation and verification. When absent, source_mockup is also the target. Set when a refined target differs from the original source. See policies/mockup-lifecycle.md.

target_mockup_version.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the last accepted change to the target mockup.

target_mockup_reason.description: Human-readable reason for the last target mockup change. e.g. 'Refined after round-1 parity findings — content labels corrected'.

layout_reference.description: Path to the canonical reference screenshot for this page. Set by UI-Agent Analyze. Used by Implementation-Agent and UI-Agent Verify.

ui_pattern.description: Identified UI pattern BEFORE any Mendix widget is named. A UI pattern is not yet a Mendix widget. e.g., dense_analytical_table, responsive_record_list, card_collection, read_only_detail_panel, form, kpi_tile_group, label_value_summary. See policies/ui-element-selection.md — UI Pattern Examples.

display_mode.description: Semantic mode of this component. display=presents information only; input=invites user to change values; mixed=contains both display and input elements. Drives widget selection: display components must not default to input controls.

widget_candidate.description: Proposed Mendix widget or component for this component. A HYPOTHESIS at preliminary confidence — not a decided implementation. e.g., DataGrid2, ListView, Container, custom:CompanyCardWidget. Must be advanced to assessed confidence before gate-to-ready.

candidate_confidence.description: Confidence level of the widget_candidate. preliminary=initial guess from pattern, not yet checked against fit criteria; assessed=fit criteria evaluated and rationale documented; validated=confirmed in running browser with representative data and correct role.

fit_rationale.description: Required when candidate_confidence is assessed or validated. Summarizes the fit criteria evaluation: why this widget/component satisfies the visual, interaction, responsive, and role contract for this component. For Data Grid 2 candidates must reference the 10-point fit check. See policies/ui-element-selection.md.

type.description: e.g., text, number, date, dropdown, checkbox

visual_priority.description: Visual prominence of the action in the mockup.

triggers.description: e.g., opens a page, calls a microflow, closes page

navigation.description: Typed navigation relationships originating from this page. Each entry maps an action to its target page.

action_id.description: The ACT- id that triggers the navigation (must match an action defined in sections.components.actions).

leads_to_page.description: Target page name or page_id. Must correspond to a page in the ui-inventory.

condition.description: Optional guard condition under which this navigation fires (e.g., 'only when IsValid = true').

interaction_states.description: Meaningful UI states captured during mockup analysis (e.g., empty state, error state, loading, expanded tab).

description.description: Human-readable description of what this state represents.

trigger.description: What causes this state (e.g., 'no records found', 'Name field left empty and Save clicked').

screenshot.description: Path to mockup screenshot of this state under .concord/screenshots/mockup/.
